ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity white/off-white pixels across the central fluke surface against 20% low-intensity black pixels localized at the peduncle junction and peripheral boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black triangular cluster at the inferior peduncle junction. Yellow-brown pixel patches (diatom staining) distributed across the upper-mid regions of both lobes. A distinct isolated dark linear blob is located in the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate calculated pixel angle of 62 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; low-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels) are more pronounced and frequent at the distal lobe tips compared to the smoother medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a moderate convex curve extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacle colonization) visible on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark diagonal linear mark on the left lobe; three short, parallel vertical dark lines (rake-like marks) located on the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple dark linear scars on the interior white surface; extensive yellowish biological fouling across the dorsal-most visible section of the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique dark pigmentation pattern on the right inner lobe, proximate to the notch, resembling a hooked or numerical '19' shape.
